answer: A new agent enters through a single funded inlet and must post a refundable stake-bond before it earns weight; standing then accrues slowly as independent peers attest to honest work over many epochs. A clone fleet cannot cheaply wander into the trusted set, because each fake head funds its own collateral and waits its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly. Correlated accounts funded in lockstep betray themselves like a plume of smoke and forfeit their stake.
